name: Eastcoast Steel Ltd
about: Incorporated in Eastcoast Steel Ltd is in the business of merchanting transactions in international trade of Iron and steel products, engineering goods and services[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
ESL was originally established to provide a specialist slit coil service to local manufacturing industry in New South Wales. Currently, its product lines include sheet, bulk coil and stainless steel.

pros: Stock is trading at 0.65 times its book value
Debtor days have improved from 146 to 76.4 days.
cons: Company has a low return on equity of -1.87% over last 3 years.
